pages.title: Finding Adamantine
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 0 to 30. Veins target up to 3 blocks, with 3 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 6.

pages.title: Working Adamantine
pages.text: Smelt Adamantine Ore or Adamantine Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 2943 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 10.5.$(br)Material damage bonus: 5.0.$(br)Enchantability: 22.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 3.5.$(br)Enchantability: 8.$(br)Extra full-set health: 20.0 HP.

pages.title: Equipment: Inclusions
pages.text: Eating food regenerates equipment durability, not eating any food slowly destroys equipment. Durability repair amount depends on how many food points the item gives. Durability decreases with a frequence of 1 to 6 seconds depending on how hungry the player is

pages.title: Armor: Symbiosis
pages.text: Receiving fatal damage will cause one of the armor pieces to sacrifice itself. Every Armor piece will increase the chance of surviving death by 25% (with a maximum of 100% when wearing full set)
